page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one column on the right; marginal notes in the left margin beside the text ("Docent nos à Deo pendere.", "Exéplo Dauidis."). Verse lines in italic below the paragraph. Catchword "Et" at lower right. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: quòd cùm nec serant, nec metant, neque co-gant in horrea, attamen pater noster cœlestis singulos alit: deinde in eo quòd cùm duo pas-serculi assario væneant, vnus tamen ex iis non cadet humi sine patre vestro, inquit Christus. Docent nos à Deo pendere.Vtinam verò duorum istorum locorum sen-tentiam apprimè teneremus, & perpetua me-moria recoleremus, vt in iis apertissimam Dei prouidentiam obseruaremus, quam si diligen-ter expéderemus, maximis curarum molibus, grauissimis timoribus & anxietatibus animi quibus perpetuò distorquemur, tandem aliquando liberaremur. Nam si verba Christi bene ponderentur à nobis, quibus ait, nos si-hi, cùm simus sui filij, longè chariores esse quàm quasuis auiculas, inde profectò colli-geremus, cùm illarum curam à se non abii-ciat, potiori ratione futurum vt suorum do-mesticorum curam gerat, vt ne quid eis desit vel quod ad victum, vel quod ad vestitum per-tineat, ac tandem cum ipso Dauide in Psal. 23. Exéplo Dauidis.ita exclamaremus.
main_text.l: Quid frustra rabidi me petitis canes?
Sicut pastor ouem, me dominus regit
Nunc pascor, placide nunc saturum latus

page.notes: The catchword "Et" is printed at lower right. Marginal notes on the left are rendered as notes beside the paragraph. Some words are blurred by the scan and read with uncertainty, e.g. "Lunor" (possibly "Lunor" for "Lunor"), "quibus ait" and "quàm quasuis". The line "Psal. 23." is as printed.
